BiblicalUsage: Naphtuhim is an Egyptian tribe descended from Mizraim, named in the table of nations. In Genesis 10:13 Mizraim begets Ludim and Anamim and Lehabim and Naphtuhim, and in 1 Chronicles 1:11 the same list is given again in the genealogy of the nations.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the table of nations is God's census of the whole world, not just of Israel. Naphtuhim is counted among the peoples, and the counting means they matter to Him.
